Theme

Tools, fasteners & household repair

reel noun

also spool

modern

M-O s.v. spool, reel, bobbin
M-O s.v. reel

fūsus, fūsī m.

noun, second declension

spindle; later also spool, reel

Morgan–Owens records the spool / reel sense, citing Eichenseer and Helfer. This does not establish an ancient portable cable-storage device.

Examples

  • Fūniculum in fūsum involve.

    Wind the cable onto the reel.composed

  • Fūniculum ēvolve.

    Unwind the cable.composed

See also cable reel, windlass, electric cable.
